en: Also important to know is the fact that just
calling SQL, just setting up such a SQL
tagged template literal
does not do anything
until you await it. So await is kind of the
keyword that then leads to the statements,
the query to actually being executed.
Without await,
you could store the result
of type SQL somewhere
So I could set up my query
like that
and that would do nothing.
At this point, nothing would be sent to the
database, nothing would be happening. So you
can prepare it and just as with the SQLite
client, of course, Bun will do some caching
and optimizations, but it will only be
executed once you await it. That is
important to understand.
